Beta Update - TLS Client Fingerprint Proxies over TLS can now reproduce the TLS ClientHello of a real client, with the new client-fingerprint parameter: • apple-26 : Apple's system TLS stack, as sent by Safari and by apps using NSURLSession: iOS 26–27, macOS 26–27, Safari 26–27 • chromium-155 : Chrome 155–158 and the browsers built on Chromium • auto (default): The recommended fingerprint, currently apple-26 Proxy = trojan, example.com, 443, password=pwd, client-fingerprint=chromium-155 It applies to HTTPS, SOCKS5-TLS, HTTP/2 CONNECT, Trust Tunnel, Trojan, AnyTLS, and VMess/VLESS with TLS or REALITY. The fp value of a share link is converted automatically. Since auto is the default, every TLS proxy now looks like Apple's system traffic out of the box; use none to keep the old behavior. Surge's TLS is built on BoringSSL, the same library Chrome uses, and Apple's TLS stack runs on its own fork of it. The fingerprints therefore come from the library itself rather than from a template: GREASE values, extension order and ECH GREASE are generated the same way as in the original clients, and the rest of the handshake follows the same code.

💊 关闭 macOS 菜单栏“蓝色药丸”提示的方法 在 macOS 27.3 Beta 2 中，苹果在菜单栏引入了“透明度指示器”，当某个应用正在控制另一个应用时，屏幕顶部会出现蓝色“药丸”状提示。苹果表示，该功能旨在让用户更清楚地了解系统与应用保护覆盖（System & App Protection Override）的使用情况，从而提升自动化操作的透明度。 不过，对于经常使用自动化工具、窗口管理器或系统增强软件的 Mac 用户而言，这个蓝色指示器可能长期占据菜单栏空间，带来视觉干扰。科技媒体 9to5Mac 主编 Zac Hall 分享了通过终端命令隐藏该提示的方法。 ▫️ 该操作仅隐藏指示器，不会撤销相关应用已获得的控制权限，也不会将应用从权限列表中移除。 打开终端应用，依次输入以下两条命令： sudo mkdir -p /Library/Preferences/FeatureFlags/Domain sudo defaults write /Library/Preferences/FeatureFlags/Domain/TCC AX_TRANSPARENCY_INDICATOR -dict Enabled -bool false 输入管理员密码并重启 Mac 后，蓝色提示即可消失。 #资讯 #数码
